mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS examId, e.exam_name AS examName, p.total_score AS totalScore, e.start_time AS examTime, es.submit_time AS submitTime, es.total_score AS examScore, e.duration AS examDuration, es.status AS studentExamStatus FROM exam_student es INNER JOIN exam e ON es.exam_id = e.id INNER JOIN paper p ON e.paper_id = p.id WHERE es.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY e.start_time DESC
